From Magician's Red · Price: Full power needs the target in your stand's line of sight within 30 ft of your stand; all of your Flame's ranges and areas are measured from your stand, not from you.

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 1 action: your stand throws a fire ankh at a creature within 30 ft: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[fire]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}); on a failure it takes 1d6 persistent fire.
  • 5: Surge, 2 actions: a @Template[cone|distance:30]{30-ft cone} of @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[fire]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}) from your stand's space, or a @Template[burst|distance:15]{15-ft burst} of @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[fire]] within 30 ft (Cross Fire Hurricane); either spares creatures you choose; a creature that fails takes the ankh's persistent fire. Twin ankhs: each ankh action fires an ankh at up to 2 creatures within 30 ft (each @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[fire]], @Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}). Burning binding: a creature that fails against an ankh or the surge is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{grabbed} by flame ropes for 1 round.
  • 9: No change.
  • 13: Surge, 1 action: ankhs at up to 6 creatures, each @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[fire]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 17: Persistent fire from your Flame rises to 2d6, the ankh action fires at up to 3 creatures, and the cone or burst surge deals @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[fire]] plus @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[fire]].

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
